🎬 The Great Gilly Hopkins (2015)

The Great Gilly Hopkins follows Gilly Hopkins, a fiercely independent and sharp-tongued 12-year-old girl who has spent much of her childhood moving between foster homes. Intelligent, rebellious, and determined to protect herself from disappointment, Gilly has developed a reputation for challenging authority and pushing away anyone who attempts to get close to her. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she is placed in the home of Maime Trotter, a warmhearted and unconventional foster mother who refuses to give up on her despite her difficult behavior. Initially determined to escape her new surroundings and reunite with her biological mother, Gilly creates elaborate plans and causes trouble for the people around her. However, as she spends more time with Trotter, her timid foster brother William Ernest, and their kindhearted neighbor Mr. Randolph, she gradually begins discovering the comfort of genuine friendship and unconditional love. Through emotional challenges, unexpected acts of kindness, and difficult lessons about trust, Gilly starts questioning her assumptions about family and belonging. As new developments threaten the stability she has finally begun to experience, she must confront the complicated difference between the family she dreams of having and the people who have truly been there for her. Combining heartfelt performances, gentle humor, and emotional storytelling, The Great Gilly Hopkins explores foster care, friendship, acceptance, forgiveness, personal growth, and the extraordinary meaning of family.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m • PG

🎥 Director: Stephen Herek

✍️ Writer: David Paterson, based on the novel by Katherine Paterson
